title: 의천
prompt: Educational textbook illustration in realistic light ink-and-watercolor washes, soft natural light, restrained harmonious colors and subtle paper texture. Carefully depict 고려 Korea of this period: period-appropriate architecture, clothing and tools. No readable text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks. No graphic violence or blood. A robed Buddhist monk in his forties standing in the courtyard of a newly finished temple hall, one hand holding a bound sutra volume, junior monks sweeping the stone yard behind him, a wooden bracket-set roof and plain timber pillars, pine trees and low hills beyond the wall, early autumn light. Invent an individual face; do not resemble any identifiable modern person or any official standardized portrait. Every book spine, scroll, sheet of paper, chart, map, placard and banner in the scene is completely plain and blank: no lettering, characters, glyphs, numerals or symbols of any script.
basis: 1097년 국청사에서 천태종을 열었다는 민족문화대백과 의천 항목과 고려사 대각국사 열전(始創天台宗, 置于國淸寺)
caveats: 의천의 얼굴과 국청사 건물 모습은 고증 복원이 아니라 표현이다.
promptNote: 1차 생성본이 책등·종이·현수막의 글자 모양으로 탈락 → 무지(無地) 지시 추가
